statistic.sample: US adults, men; women reported separately

source: McCrae & Costa 1989, Journal of Personality 57:17-40, doi:10.1111/j.1467-6494.1989.tb00759.x (coefficient as tabulated in a secondary source)
scope: population-level only; never for converting one person's result
lost: Types versus dimensions: a type collapses a continuous score into a pole, and the 1989 instrument forms differ from current ones.
forbiddenUse: Never estimate one person's Big Five score from a type, and never output a branded type label from Big Five or other data (M-4).
reopenWhen: The coefficient is re-read from the primary article's tables.
